title: Involution and Commutator Length in PU(n,1)
summary: We study decompositions of holomorphic isometries of complex hyperbolic space into holomorphic involutions. We prove that, for every n>=3, the involution length of PU(n,1) is 4. This improves the higher-dimensional upper bound 8 of Paupert--Will, as well as the projective upper bound 5 implied by Bünger's linear decomposition theorem, to the optimal value 4. Combined with the two-dimensional result of Paupert--Will, this shows that the involution length of PU(n,1) is 4 for every n>=2.
